trustStoreType.description: TLS truststore type ex: JKS, PKCS12

keyStoreType.description: TLS keystore type ex: JKS, PKCS12

httpsProtocols.description: A single string formatted as a comma-separated list of accepted https protocols, ie: "TLSv1.2,TLSv1.3"

sslMode.description: Controls the level of security and verification applied when establishing an SSL connection.

alias.description: The alias to use for the keystore. By default, this will use the keystore type.

clientCertificates.description: The X.509 public certificate chain that corresponds to the private key.

caCertificates.description: The trusted X.509 root CA certificates. You will need to download this from your host provider.

privateKey.description: The PKCS1 or PKCS8 private key. This is required when sslMode = VERIFY_FULL

privateKeyPassword.description: The private key password, if encrypted

title: Spec used to generate encrypted keystore files
name: TlsCertificate.KeyStoreSpec
